scope: Compact reader, stable aligned actions, collapsible reporting, record loading masks and explicit custom-date refresh.

notes: Initial44-case run passed40; one legacy metadata selector and three mock-SSE timing cases were corrected, then affected20-case rerun passed. Final loading guard passed10 related cases plus1 new inert/late-close case.
No backend code changed; previous301-case backend checkpoint remains dated evidence and was not rerun.
No new live retrieval, caption acquisition or model work was performed. The live app was not restarted.
Custom date edits refresh on explicit Apply range & search, preserving saved history and selected sources.
